card.name: Noun right after a modifier, before 'of/for'
card.fires_on: A common English noun (risk, therapy, use, pregnancy, situations) that comes just after an adjective or article and is about to be followed by a prepositional phrase. It is mostly seen in label instructions such as 'Advise of the potential risk'.

modes.label: Potential risk
modes.description: The word risk after 'potential' in advise-the-patient statements.
modes.example: Advise males of the potential<< risk>> of exposure through semen and to use condoms

modes.label: Treatment nouns
modes.description: Nouns like therapy, use or pregnancy after a modifier in clinical instructions.

modes.label: General web nouns
modes.description: Everyday nouns or prepositions in non-medical web text, ahead of a following phrase.
modes.example: Visit your local recycling center to find out what is accepted<< at>> which specific centers on the island.
